notes:
Summary: Lodestar DevTools builds an IDE copilot embedded in VS Code and JetBrains IDEs for enterprise developer teams. Primary concern is predictable latency and throughput for interactive completion + streaming during peak developer hours (US-PST 10:30-17:30 & EMEA overlap). They want Dedicated capacity with burst policy and explicit model/version pinning for stability.

Recent activity:
- 2024-10-05: Initial demo (Ava) — showed hosted API flow; customer asked about latency tail and token costs.
- 2024-10-16: Technical deep dive with infra team (Sanjay + Lodestar infra) — discussed VPC connectors, private agent, and KMS integration. Fireflies ff-7123984.
- 2024-10-30: Load profile provided by Lodestar: 1200 concurrent devs at peak -> expected 400 rps for small completions, 120 rps for streaming sessions. Provided CSV traffic sample.
- 2024-11-02: Security review kickoff; Lodestar requires SOC2 report, SSO via SAML, and audit logs retention 12 months. Drive: LOD-SEC-FAQ.
- 2024-11-08: Sales + SE alignment call — agreed to 48-hour Dedicated POC scheduled to run week of 2024-11-18. Fireflies ff-7150011.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria:
- 99th percentile latency for streaming token response <= 200ms across US-PST dev sessions.
- Sustained throughput of 400 rps with burst headroom to 800 rps for 10-minute spikes.
- Model pinning: pin to open-code-model-v2, ability to pin patch releases for rollouts.
- KV/prefix caching to reduce repeated context cost for workspace-aware completions.
- Rollback policy / canary for model version changes; telemetry hooks for token-cost per route.

Quoted customer lines (paraphrased):
- "We cannot tolerate 500ms+ tail in completion feedback — developers will disable the copilot."
- "If we can guarantee predictable cost and a clear burst model, we can commit to Dedicated."

POC plan (brief):
- 48-hour Dedicated environment in partner region (us-west-2) with reserved pool sized to expected peak + 2x burst for first day.
- Run synthetic IDE traffic and 2 pilot teams (40 devs) using VS Code extension instrumented for latency/traces.
- Validate SLOs, fallback to smaller quantized model if latency exceeds thresholds, and exercise model pin + rollback.

Next steps (short):
- SE to provision Dedicated POC (Sanjay) and share provisioning runbook by 2024-11-12.
- Lodestar to share legal PO template and SOC2 report.
- Procurement to confirm budget by 2024-12-05.

Notes style: fragments + checklist entries, capture of verbal quotes and technical acceptance criteria.
